notes: Fixed a shift or class typed with the same start and end time counting as a full 24-hour day: a shift entered as 9:00 AM – 9:00 AM used to pay 23.5 hours and inflate the paycheck estimate, and a class entered that way used to block the whole day in Suggest and flag overlaps with everything. Equal start and end times now count as zero — a shift that ends before it starts still counts as overnight, as before.
